references.text: Describes the daily burnt offering (tamid) mentioned in Num 29:6 as the foundation for all other offerings.
Describes the new moon offering (monthly burnt offering) that Num 29:6 refers to as 'the burnt offering of the month'.
Provides detailed regulations for grain and drink offerings that were to accompany the burnt offerings, as mentioned in Num 29:6.
The original institution of the daily burnt offering (tamid) referred to in Num 29:6.
The burnt offering is described as 'a pleasing aroma to the Lord' (reach nichoach), the same expression used in Num 29:6.
Emphasizes that festival offerings are in addition to the regular offerings, as specified in Num 29:6.
Ezekiel's vision of future offerings at new moon and Sabbath, based on the principles in Num 29:6.
